title: The Morning Digest: November 14, 2026
dek: Brent Jan27 settled at $95.84 on Friday, up $0.02, and WTI Dec26 settled at $88.56, down $0.18 (Bloomberg via Rigzone, Nov 13), taking the Brent to WTI spread to $7.28 on the settles, a second straight settle above $7. The IEA's November report prints a global surplus of roughly 2 million barrels a day this quarter, the first since the war began, with October supply at 105.4 million barrels a day. Baltic Week 46 has every watched tanker route down for a second straight week, the Atlantic routes down hardest. December WCS is -$28.27 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 13) on zero lots, a seventh straight session without a trade. The validated diesel crack is $90.30.
